audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said 'Skill' at level 1 while whys[0] says Neeko out-trades it outright, gave Gangplank level 2 where whys[1] calls it a coinflip, and gave 'Skill' at 4-5 where whys[3] says Gangplank out-trades a pre-item Neeko.
audit.why: The prose is specific and internally consistent; only the chart sides were stale. Neeko has real level-1 poke and no keg exists to answer it, but by 4-5 the second Powder Keg point makes the trade Gangplank's.
audit.corrected: Level 1 = Neeko 4/10, Level 2 = Skill 5/10, Levels 4-5 = Gangplank 6/10. Level 3, 6, first item and 2+ items unchanged.

audit.whatIsWrong: Pop Blossom is described as making Neeko 'briefly untargetable' — not in Riot's description. Tangle-Barbs is described as 'extends through targets' with no cooldown, range, or the actual growth rule.
audit.why: Riot's R text is 'leaps into the air, knocking up all nearby enemies. Upon landing, nearby enemies are damaged and stunned. The preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised.' No untargetability. Riot's E text: 'If the tangle kills an enemy or passes through a champion, it becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer' — so hiding behind a dying minion makes the root worse, which is the opposite of the usual instinct.
audit.corrected: R rewritten around the real hidden mechanic (wind-up concealed while disguised) with its 120s cooldown; E given 12s / 1000 range and the minion-kill growth rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer refers to Neeko as 'he' throughout the trading and don'ts lines.
audit.why: Neeko is female; the content layer already uses 'she'. The two layers read as if they describe different champions.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected in the trade lines, do's, don'ts and the trading report.

edits.before: This is where you take the lane over. With a second point in Powder Keg you can drop a barrel where she farms and Parrrley-detonate it the instant she steps up, and the chained slow means a dashless squishy can't walk out of it. At 6 her Pop Blossom is the only scary beat — she goes briefly untargetable then stuns the AoE on landing — but Remove Scurvy cleanses the stun outright and heals off your missing HP, so save W for her ult and the lane swings hard. Bait her E or her clone, then punish the cooldown with a keg combo.
edits.after: This is where you take the lane over. With a second point in Powder Keg you can drop a barrel where she farms and Parrrley-detonate it the instant she steps up, and the chained slow means a dashless squishy can't walk out of it. At 6 her Pop Blossom is the only scary beat — a knock-up into a landing stun whose wind-up is hidden while she is disguised — but Remove Scurvy cleanses the stun outright and heals off your missing HP, so save W for her ult. Bait her E (12s), then punish the cooldown with a keg combo.
